svg.aria-label: agentcore-loan-servicing-agent: A loan-servicing agent built for Bedrock AgentCore, with tool access decided by Cedar policy, not prompts. 60 / 60: gate cases pass; policy denied 21 of 85 tool calls. Local AWS emulator and a scripted model. Not deployed.
